title_en: The Drim flows through the middle of Struga
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Reads like a modern composed song about Struga, but I cannot name an author, so origin unclear. 'Чинам како' translated as 'I felt as if' (my reading).

lines.en: I know a city on a lake
like a dewy flowering garden,
city of the Miladinov brothers,

lines.cyr: град на мостови, песни и убавина.
lines.lat: grad na mostovi, pesni i ubavina.
lines.en: city of bridges, songs and beauty.
The Drim flows through the middle of Struga,
there is no other like Struga,

lines.cyr: кај да одиш, кај да шеташ,
lines.lat: kaj da odiš, kaj da šetaš,
lines.en: wherever you go, wherever you stroll,
you will return here again.
I do not live in Struga,

lines.cyr: но ја носам вечно во душава,
lines.lat: no ja nosam večno vo dušava,
lines.en: but I carry it forever in my soul,
when I first fell in love,

lines.cyr: чинам како вторпат да се родив.
lines.lat: činam kako vtorpat da se rodiv.
lines.en: I felt as if I were born a second time.

there is no other like Struga,
